לא קשיא: הא -- דמחמו ליה וחאים, הא -- דמחמו ליה ולא חאים

R' Eliezer: repent one day before your death
Abaye to Rabba: one like the Master, whom all of Pumbedita hate -- who will stir the eulogy?
R' Elazar asked Rav: who is ben olam haba?

R' Yochanan ben Zakkai: a parable of a king who invited his servants to a feast and set them no time; the wise adorned themselves and sat at the king's door ('is the king's house lacking anything?'), the fools went to their work ('is there a feast without toil?')
suddenly the king called his servants ... he said: those who adorned themselves shall sit and eat and drink; those who did not adorn themselves for the feast shall stand and watch
R' Meir: they too would look like attendants
alternatively: 'at all times let your garments be white' -- this is tzitzit
מאי טעמא? הני אדם, האי לאו אדם
a donkey and a deaf-mute, imbecile and minor: he places it on the donkey; he does not give it to the deaf-mute, imbecile or minor
דתניא: רבי יצחק אומר משום רבי אליעזר: תרומת חרש לא תצא לחולין מפני שהוא ספק
a deaf-mute and a minor, what? according to R' Eliezer you have no question
the mishna: and if there is no gentile with him, he places it on the donkey
the mishna: if there is no gentile with him, he places it on the donkey
why did the Sages permit him to give his pouch to a gentile? -- the Sages hold it established that a person does not restrain himself over his money
